falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts by more than -50bps from current level
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion contradicts the pattern's embedded assumption of curve steepening/recovery pricing; signals recession acceleration not bottom formation
